summary: Stash is a self-hosted media library organiser and player designed specifically for adult collections. It includes automated tagging capabilities and metadata scraping to help you catalogue and browse your files through a web interface.
goodFor: This is a suitable choice if you manage a large, local collection of adult media and want a dedicated web interface to organise and stream it.
watchOut: The AGPL-3.0 licence places copyleft requirements on your deployment if you modify and distribute the source code, and dealing with extensive metadata scraping can consume significant storage and network resources.
deployNotes: As a containerised Go application, deployment typically involves Docker with persistent volumes mapped for media storage and a reverse proxy configured to handle HTTPS traffic.
